offerings.name: Zellige
offerings.description: Morocco -- 800+ years; Surface texture, sheen, chips/pits/crazing as characteristics. 200+ tiles, mesh-backed mosaics. Not suitable for freeze/thaw outdoors.

offerings.name: Cement tile
offerings.description: Vietnam -- 19th-c European; Mineral pigments, cement, hydraulic press, never fired. Matte. 68 colors. Suitable for exterior in non-freeze/thaw only.

offerings.name: Cotto
offerings.description: San Miguel de Allende, MX; Unglazed, earthy, high-fired. Six colorways. Suitable for any climate including freeze/thaw. Not for pools/spas.

offerings.name: Cotto Allende
offerings.description: San Miguel de Allende, MX; Same clay as Cotto, hand-glazed. Eighteen colorways. Suitable for pools/spas. Not suitable for outdoor freeze/thaw.

offerings.name: Marble
offerings.description: Italy + Spain; Carrara, Nero Marquina, Grigio Carnico, Rosso Alicante, Giallo Reale, Verdi Alpi. Honed or polished. Can be used outdoors in appropriate climates.

offerings.name: Cantera Stone
offerings.description: Mexico; Volcanic stone, 7 earthy colorways. Visible aggregate + mineral inclusions. Indoor + outdoor.

offerings.name: Ceramics
offerings.description: Central Japan (Nagoya); Molded + glazed, high-temp. "Field Trip: Japan" sub-line is extruded + die-cut. Matte / satin / glossy.

offerings.name: Custom / Special Orders
offerings.description: Cement 10-12 wks, Cotto 11-15 wks, Zellige 13-17 wks. Cannot be cancelled once placed.

offerings.name: Glass Mosaics
offerings.description: Northern Spain; 98% recycled glass, renewable energy production. Hand-placed on 12x12 grids. 7 patterns.

offerings.name: Limestone
offerings.description: Fez, Morocco + Bordeaux, France; Quarried solid blocks. Honed or bush-hammered. Natural patina over time.

offerings.name: Roman Mosaics
offerings.description: Italian stone heritage; Same premium stone as Solid Marble; intricate ancient-Rome-inspired mosaic patterns.

offerings.name: Sample Ordering
offerings.description: $3 per sample; first 5 free for trade. Up to 10 per client (max 4 per unique tile). Ships within 2 business days from LA. FedEx or UPS ground.

offerings.name: Terra Forms
offerings.description: Specialty; Sculptural / dimensional tile. Texture + relief beyond flat-tile installations.

offerings.name: Terrazzo
offerings.description: Venetian-inspired tile made with steel molds, crushed marble or stone, hydraulic press, grinding, and polishing.

offerings.name: Trade Program
offerings.description: Program for designers, architects, contractors, and installers with trade pricing, rep support, samples, previews, tracking, and order help.

offerings.name: Warehouse Pickup
offerings.description: Free for full orders, LA warehouse. Appointment required. Team contacts customer when ready.

offerings.name: Worldwide Shipping
offerings.description: LTL curbside pallet shipping, with custom quotes for Alaska, Hawaii, Canada, and international orders.

offerings.name: Field Trip Japan
offerings.description: Extruded and die-cut Japanese ceramic sub-line.

offerings.name: Unglazed Natural Zellige
offerings.description: Unglazed Moroccan zellige colorway for earthy, matte installations.

offerings.name: Unglazed Cotto
offerings.description: Suitable for exterior use in any climate, including freeze/thaw regions. This is a selling point.
